approval: Owner approved bounded JSON-gzip review support through the question tool.
scope: Committed branch and commit reviews. Local and unsupported binary reviews retain their previous refusal.
behavior: Retain compressed Git object IDs, file modes, rename metadata, JSON tokens, duplicate keys, and numeric precision.
Reject malformed JSON/gzip, optional gzip headers, concatenated members, cross-format renames, and non-regular files.
Scan decoded additions and deletions through deterministic checks and the existing TruffleHog preflight.
Keep all existing prompt byte limits and complete-input requirements.
